system.level_up: Level Up! You gained +4 Attribute Points!

moss_slime.name: Moss Slime
moss_slime.lore: A bouncy slime born from moist moss in the Whispering Forest.

wild_mushroom.name: Wild Mushroom
wild_mushroom.lore: A mobile fungus that charges aggressively at forest trespassers.

forest_rabbit.name: Forest Rabbit
forest_rabbit.lore: A nimble rabbit that flees swiftly when gravely wounded.

thorn_boar.name: Thorn Boar
thorn_boar.lore: A ferocious wild boar covered in sharp defensive quills.

bark_beetle.name: Bark Beetle
bark_beetle.lore: A sturdy beetle armored with thick tree-bark chitin.

forest_wolf.name: Forest Wolf
forest_wolf.lore: A nocturnal pack hunter whose howl boosts pack attack power.

poison_mushroom.name: Poison Mushroom
poison_mushroom.lore: An ancient toxic fungus emitting deadly poisonous spores.

goblin_scout.name: Goblin Scout
goblin_scout.lore: A sneaky scout armed with slingshots and glue traps.

goblin_warrior.name: Goblin Warrior
goblin_warrior.lore: A brutal frontline fighter wielding a cleaving axe.

verdant_guardian.name: Verdant Guardian
verdant_guardian.lore: The colossal treant protector of the Whispering Forest.

elysia_capital.name: Elysia Capital
elysia_capital.desc: The glorious capital and economic heart of the realm.

ember_village.name: Ember Village
ember_village.desc: A peaceful starter village nestled under cherry blossoms.

dexica_sanctuary.name: Dexica Sanctuary
dexica_sanctuary.desc: The sacred holy cathedral where Level 10 First Job Awakening occurs.

whispering_forest.name: Whispering Forest
whispering_forest.desc: A lush beginner hunting ground teeming with nature spirits.

goblin_outpost.name: Goblin Outpost
goblin_outpost.desc: A fortified stockade built by savage goblin clans.

misty_lake.name: Misty Lake
misty_lake.desc: A fog-shrouded lake connecting the frontier to the capital.

ember_wastes.name: Ember Wastes
ember_wastes.desc: Barren scorched badlands under smoking volcanic peaks.

flame_cavern.name: Flame Cavern
flame_cavern.desc: A hazardous molten dungeon full of rare minerals and drakes.

frostveil_highlands.name: Frostveil Highlands
frostveil_highlands.desc: Glacial highlands enveloped in eternal snowstorms.

graveveil.name: Graveveil
graveveil.desc: A haunted valley of tombs walked by restless spirits.

town_scroll.name: Town Return Scroll
town_scroll.desc: Teleports the user back to Ember Village. [Key T]

novice_slash.name: Novice Slash
novice_slash.desc: A physical sword strike dealing 115% physical damage. [Key 1]

novice_fireball.name: Lesser Fireball
novice_fireball.desc: Hurls a flame sphere dealing 145% fire damage. [Key 2]

novice_spin.name: Whirlwind Spin
novice_spin.desc: Spins in a 360-degree radius hitting all nearby foes. [Key 4]

novice_shield.name: Diamond Barrier
novice_shield.desc: Creates a 65 HP shield and grants +25% DEF for 8s. [Key 5]
